code:
# Inspect an object file
nm hello.o          # list symbols: T = defined, U = undefined
objdump -d hello.o  # disassemble machine code
readelf -s hello.o  # detailed symbol table
description: These tools show symbols, disassembled code, and the detailed symbol table in an object file.

steps.description: nm lists symbols and marks defined symbols with T and undefined symbols with U.
objdump disassembles the object file's machine code.
readelf displays the detailed symbol table.

title: Inspect object-file metadata
